title: Create Horizons - Aeronautical Engineering
description: A modpack inspired by the Create and Create Aeronautics mod for engineer masterminds who love to assemble and fabricate. The modpack includes tons of Create addons and a PvP styled claim system.
body:
![The Create Past The Horizons Update 1.3 Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91dda388d49d07d99d4465ca5cb19b1c0711f152.png)

**Version 1.3 "Past The Horizons" is currently in development, Create Aeronautics will be implemented.**

Create Horizons is a modpack designed for the official Create Horizons SMP by JufoCraft. Feel free to use this modpack on your own SMP or anywhere else.

This modpack features the Create mod and tons of addons that match perfectly for a steampunk type gameplay.
There is also a claim system designed for PvP servers and many mods that balance the PvP experience.
Create Horizons has a server file that you can install on any dedicated server website with a click of a button.
